arguments.value: MJ Syndicated, Inc. and Simply Herbals formed a Florida joint venture to manufacture and sell health-related products for a fixed term from November 27, 2018 to November 30, 2019. Each party contributes capital or property, cannot withdraw capital without consent, and profits and losses are shared based on each party’s capital contributions. Major financial decisions require unanimous approval, while day-to-day management and contract binding generally require majority approval. MJ Syndicated, Inc. serves as the tax matters participant and handles tax filings. The venture keeps GAAP books, provides annual reports, allows audits, and holds quarterly meetings. New participants can join only by unanimous consent. A participant may withdraw with 30 days’ written notice, but withdrawal or certain events like death, incapacity, misconduct, breach, or prohibited competition can trigger dissolution or removal. On dissolution, debts are paid first and remaining assets are distributed by capital contribution shares. The agreement restricts conflicts of interest, unauthorized acts, and commitments outside the venture’s purpose, and requires indemnification for good-faith actions, liability protection, insurance, Florida jurisdiction, and unanimous consent for amendments.
